category_title: Struggling readers who use collaborative talk to clarify text confusion
minimal_context: Jennifer is participating in designated classroom reading time with the goal of reading a novel independently.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for independent reading. Please choose a novel from the shelf and read quietly at your desk.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Spends a large amount of time looking through the books on the shelf without selecting one) My interest has gone down in middle school. I hate reading. Reading is boring.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please just select a book and sit down to read.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits down with a book and starts skimming the text pictures and captions instead of reading) Some of the words are hard. I don’t get it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep reading and see if you can figure it out.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the book away, completely disengaged) I get to the point that I barely understand it. I'm just confused by it.
